lines.en: My long ears skim the door frame
I walk the corridor step by step
My pace is slow but never stops
My joints squeak as they turn
I ease out from the corner
My claws stay at my sides
The floor complains where I pass
I shift myself along the boards
My shadow slides along the wall
I put my head into the room first
I drag my steps toward you
I work my way to the doorway
I stand with my ears hanging
My eyes do not blink
My teeth are the longest of all
I tilt my head at the floor
My cloth is full of loose threads
My jaw opens and closes slowly
I listen to the floor above
I have no need to breathe
My claws scrape the boards
Even standing, I seem to watch
I count the rooms
One of my ears twitches
One of my ears is missing.
I lift my chin

lines.zh: 我的影子和墙混在一起
lines.en: My shadow blends with the wall
My ears turn toward you
You stand at the end of my corridor
Your head reaches only my shoulder
I open my mouth to show my teeth
You grip what you hold
I touch the door frame
Where do you think you can run
I lower my face toward you
You did not cry out

lines.zh: 我的眼睛在你身上停住
lines.en: My eyes settle on you
You are smaller than I expected
I wait for you to reach the wall
My ears sink down slowly

lines.zh: 我的布面撕开一道口子
lines.en: A seam has torn open in my fabric
Didn't even wobble. Not a bone creaked.
Parts rattle inside me
I touch the dent with one hand
My ears twitch once
I slowly straighten my head
I feel no pain whatsoever
Before you hit me, I was just looking around.
My steps stay steady
Your strength is not small
Holding it high does nothing
I have no tongue to taste with
This does not draw me
My eyes are on you, not on it
Move it, it blocks my hand

lines.zh: 我嘴里全是牙，没有胃口
lines.en: My mouth is all teeth and no hunger
Keep the bread for yourself
I need no fuel

lines.zh: 你撞在我身上没推动我
lines.en: You hit me and did not move me

lines.zh: 我的重量把我钉在原地
lines.en: My weight pins me in place
You are thrown back a step
My casing gives a dull thump
I am barely pushed back
Your force almost amuses me
I look down at your red hand
My ears sway a little
That momentum means nothing

lines.zh: 你撞上来，我的耳朵都没晃
lines.en: You hit me and not even my ears sway
There are no other rabbits here
My kin are iron and cloth
I do not speak of that
I leave my words to my teeth
I walk this building alone
I need no companion
You ask the wrong thing
I go on in silence
I pick up an old screw
I press it back into my hand
I pick up a scrap of cloth
I stuff it into a loose seam
It deforms in my claw
This is not one of my parts
I drop it back in the corridor
I keep it, it may be useful
I do not mean to give it back
You entered my sight
My ears have gone straight up
My first choice is you
I open my jaw wide
My claws are already spread
There is only you in this building
I heard you kick the chair
My target is settled
You are on the inside of that door
I wait for you to step out
I lock onto your position
My shadow reaches the doorway first
You have no second route
I push the door open
My steps have not stopped
You are upstairs, I know
I press an ear to the wall
I have no need to run at all
This floor has only two doors
Turning off the light will not help
I take the stairs two at a time
Your breathing is behind that door
I stop at the door and listen
I rest a hand on the handle
I work my way toward you
I am in no rush at all
You are counting the rooms left
I block the corridor lights
One more step and you hit the wall
I do not need to see you
My claws come down from my shoulder
I shove you into the wall
My teeth close on your arm
I sweep my arm across
That did not knock you back
I press you downward

lines.zh: 我的耳朵在我挥动时甩
lines.en: My ears swing as I strike
Your guard is battered open
I drag you closer
My jaw snaps shut with a click
My hand is up again
My claws rake through cloth
That one lands on your shoulder
You take a step and hold
I did not stop my hand
My teeth arrive before my arm
The corridor light stutters
I show myself out of the dark
My ears appear past the door frame
A trail of noise crosses the floor
I stand taller than the door
My claws rest on the door frame
I walk slowly into the light

lines.zh: 你听见的第一声是我的关节
lines.en: The first sound you hear is my joints
I duck my head to enter
There is someone in the building again
My shadow reaches the floor first
Someone left the door open
My ears sway in the draft
I come out of the storage room
My shadow presses against the door
I stop in the middle of the corridor
My ears brush the hanging lamp
Fire curls my cloth

lines.zh: 我落地时压塌了一块地板
lines.en: My landing buckles the floorboards

lines.zh: 水灌进我的耳朵，我闷住了
lines.en: Water fills my ears and muffles me
The blast pushes me back

lines.zh: 一支箭卡在我的肩缝里
lines.en: An arrow sticks in my shoulder seam
Magic stiffens my joints

lines.zh: 我不吃东西，只是零件松了
lines.en: I never eat, my parts just loosen
Lightning runs through my frame
My ears still sway as I fall
